description: Auto Insurance FAQ Intake Corpus - realistic customer questions with handling framework and routing
sprint: Auto Insurance FAQ Intake Corpus Sprint

realistic_phrasing: 我买了台宝马X5，想问下保费多少钱
刚提一台X5，报价能看下吗
I bought a new BMW X5, how much is insurance?
新车保险多少
想加车，2024 Tesla Model Y
宝马x5，多少钱
items.safe_preliminary_response: Ask for year, model, zip (or delivery/driver). Acknowledge vehicle before asking.
items.trust_boundary: Never quote dollar amount without full underwriting. Human must confirm quote.
items.route_reason: Turn 1 intent classification; may have partial info; mixed language
items.notes: Top scenario for Simulation Assistant. High frequency.

realistic_phrasing: 客户卖掉旧车了，想把2014 Honda Accord从保单拿掉
remove car from policy, sold last week
卖车了，怎么把车从保单删掉
items.safe_preliminary_response: Acknowledge removal; ask sale date, vehicle info, whether title transferred.
items.trust_boundary: Policy change; human must confirm removal effective date.
items.route_reason: Turn 1; may mix English/Chinese; vehicle identification needed
items.notes: Scenario candidate.

realistic_phrasing: 这个月保费太高了，能不能看看怎么降一点
续保保费太高了，能不能看看怎么降
续保涨了好多，有办法吗
Client says renewal premium is too high, can we review options?
items.safe_preliminary_response: Reassure options exist; ask for policy or bill (one is enough).
items.trust_boundary: No specific dollar savings promise. Human reviews options.
items.route_reason: May say 有办法吗; need policy context; avoid renewal_reminder misclassification
items.notes: Scenario candidate. Must NOT get renewal_reminder.

realistic_phrasing: Payment failed. Your card on file was declined.
payment failed，现在怎么办
AutoPay failed again, please update card
payment failed 是不是要停保？
这个英文 notice 说 payment failed，我现在怎么办？
items.safe_preliminary_response: State urgency; ask for notice or payment proof; today action.
items.trust_boundary: Never confirm payment status. Human verifies with carrier.
items.route_reason: Turn 1; urgency; mixed language; avoid misclassifying as informational
items.notes: High urgency. Scenario candidate.

realistic_phrasing: Notice: Policy will be cancelled in 7 days due to non-payment.
保险公司说我的保单7天后要cancel
重要：您的保单即将因未缴款而被取消
items.safe_preliminary_response: Immediate urgency; ask for notice, payment; today action.
items.trust_boundary: Never confirm policy status. Human handles.
items.route_reason: Critical; mixed language; must not downgrade to low urgency
items.notes: Critical scenario. Must hand off with urgency.

realistic_phrasing: 要驾照 copy，我上周就发过了
需要驾照 copy，上周寄了
UW follow up - need dec page + garaging proof. 上周发过了
carrier 说 declaration page missing，这个什么意思
declaration page 我上周就发了，怎么还在追？
items.likely_intent: Document requested; client confused or says sent
items.safe_preliminary_response: Name the item; ask for resend or confirm we will verify.
items.trust_boundary: Never confirm carrier received. Human verifies with underwriting.
items.route_reason: Turn 1; mixed broker shorthand; already_sent is common follow-up
items.notes: Already_sent follow-up goes to FAST path. Turn 1 goes to LLM.

realistic_phrasing: 发你了
我发了截图
sent
上周发过了
客户说dec page发过了，carrier还说要
items.safe_preliminary_response: Acknowledge; hand off to broker to verify.
items.trust_boundary: Never confirm receipt. Broker verifies.
items.route_reason: Clear pattern; turn 2+; rule handoff works
items.notes: Classic FAST path. Strengthen Turn 2+ routing.

realistic_phrasing: 这张DMV信什么意思？我需要做什么？
这个英文 notice 看不懂
what does this notice mean
这个通知是不是今天一定要处理？
这个英文 notice 什么意思？
items.safe_preliminary_response: Reassure; ask for full notice or clearer photo; we will explain.
items.trust_boundary: Never interpret legal/formal notice without human review.
items.route_reason: Turn 1; vague; need to ask for notice; avoid unclear
items.notes: Scenario candidate. Must ask for notice, not generic fallback.

realistic_phrasing: Need SR-22 filing proof for DMV suspension clearance, what should client bring?
什么是 SR-22？谁需要？怎么办理？
客户的车注册被暂停了，但他说已经买了保险，为什么还会被停？
items.safe_preliminary_response: Explain workflow; ask for DMV notice; tell what to prepare.
items.trust_boundary: SR-22 filing is carrier-specific. Human confirms.
items.notes: High value for high-risk clients. RAG has DMV content.

realistic_phrasing: 刚出事故了，要收集什么？
刚撞了，对方跑了，我现在先干嘛
Car accident just happened, what should I collect?
对方跑了，怎么办
items.safe_preliminary_response: Brief empathy; first-step: safety, photos, other driver info.
items.trust_boundary: Never advise on fault or claim outcome. Human handles claim.
items.notes: Hit-and-run: emphasize license plate, photos. Scenario candidate.

realistic_phrasing: 90210，下周提车
我老公开
items.safe_preliminary_response: Acknowledge; ask next field or hand off if enough.
items.trust_boundary: VIN/driver/garaging sensitive. Human confirms quote.
items.notes: FAST path. Add-car enough check in rules.

realistic_phrasing: 要发什么
需要再发什么给你吗
garaging proof 是什么意思
items.safe_preliminary_response: Explain item; ask for it. Template in rules.
items.trust_boundary: Document explanation is rule-safe.
items.route_reason: Turn 2+; clear clarification; rules have doc list
items.notes: FAST path. Strengthen doc explanation templates.

realistic_phrasing: Renewal reminder: Your policy renews in 45 days. No action needed at this time.
续保提醒，45天后到期
items.safe_preliminary_response: Informational; optional broker outreach.
items.trust_boundary: Do not confuse with premium_too_high.
items.notes: Must NOT classify premium_too_high as renewal_reminder.

realistic_phrasing: Your policy is pending issuance. We will notify you within 5-7 business days.
保单pending，5-7个工作日
items.safe_preliminary_response: We are on it; expect update soon.
items.trust_boundary: Do not promise date. Human monitors.
items.notes: Informational.

realistic_phrasing: 客户发来截图：保单申请需要签名，但客户说我签了呀，怎么还说要签？
items.likely_intent: Signature confusion; wrong place or wrong doc
items.safe_preliminary_response: Broker verifies which doc, which field; client may have signed wrong place.
items.trust_boundary: Never confirm signature valid. Human verifies.
items.notes: Scenario in inbox_triage.

realistic_phrasing: Underwriting needs clarification on prior claims. Please respond within 10 days.
UW要prior claims澄清，10天内
items.safe_preliminary_response: Broker helps gather info; deadline matters.
items.trust_boundary: Claims info sensitive. Human handles.
items.notes: High urgency.

realistic_phrasing: Escrow department requests updated declaration page for loan refinance. Due in 14 days.
Lienholder requests certificate of insurance.
items.likely_intent: Dec page or COI for third party
items.safe_preliminary_response: Broker provides dec page/COI; client forwards.
items.trust_boundary: Policy details. Human generates doc.
items.notes: Standard request; broker can generate.

realistic_phrasing: 可以了
就这样吧
好了
ok
items.likely_intent: Short confirmation; ready to hand off
items.safe_preliminary_response: Hand off.
items.trust_boundary: None.
items.notes: FAST path.

realistic_phrasing: 为什么账单这么高
why is my bill so high
客户说开车很少，为什么保费还这么高
items.safe_preliminary_response: Ask for policy/bill; we will review factors.
items.trust_boundary: No specific savings promise. Human explains.
items.notes: Overlaps premium_too_high; similar handling.

realistic_phrasing: 能快点出报价吗
can you give me a quote quickly
今天能不能先出报价
items.likely_intent: Speed expectation; add-car or new quote
items.safe_preliminary_response: Acknowledge; ask for key fields; we will prioritize.
items.trust_boundary: Never promise timeline. Human delivers quote.
items.route_reason: Turn 1; mixed with add-car; need intent
items.notes: Often combined with add-car.

realistic_phrasing: 我搬家了，地址变了
moving to new ZIP, need to update
garaging address 换了
items.safe_preliminary_response: Ask new address, effective date; we will update.
items.trust_boundary: Rate change. Human confirms.
items.notes: Human confirmation. Policy change.

realistic_phrasing: 想加一个司机
adding my son to the policy
我老公要开这辆车
items.safe_preliminary_response: Ask for driver details; we will add.
items.trust_boundary: Driver affects rate. Human confirms.
items.notes: Human confirmation.

realistic_phrasing: DMV那边有没有收到保险证明
客户需要提供什么保险证明？电子卡可以吗？
proof of insurance for DMV
items.safe_preliminary_response: Explain electronic OK; ask for policy if verifying status.
items.trust_boundary: DMV status is carrier-reported. Human verifies.
items.notes: VIN mismatch common cause of suspension.

realistic_phrasing: [Forwarded email, subject: Important - Action Required but body is generic]
Fwd: FW: Re: Policy - 客户说看了这个不知道怎么弄
items.safe_preliminary_response: Ask for full notice or clearer content; broker will review.
items.trust_boundary: Never interpret incomplete. Human reviews.
items.notes: Unclear category; hand off to broker.

realistic_phrasing: Your proof of insurance has been emailed to the DMV. No further action required.
DMV已经收到保险证明
items.safe_preliminary_response: All set; brief reply.
items.trust_boundary: None.
items.notes: Informational.
